channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Muhammad Ali | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Muhammad Ali from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Donald Trump on Kobe Bryant, Tiger Woods, Martin Luther King, Muhammad Ali
item.description:
This was where he mentioned Bryant as one of the national figures.

“Martin Luther King Jr., Muhammad Ali. Not a bad athlete, what do you think, Muhammad, not too bad, and the late Kobe Bryant. People love Kobe Bryant. We're going to save Tiger Woods for another time,”

Donald Trump on Kobe Bryant, Tiger Woods, Martin Luther King, Muhammad Ali, Feb 20, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Eric Holder on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Muhammad Ali
item.description:
“It’s the kind of thing that maybe for too long athletes got away from that activist image. I grew up with Jackie Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar. Guys who were unafraid to take risks, to try to express themselves to move the nation in a better way. It is great to see these young NBA players embracing that heritage and using their voices to bring the nation along. So, as I said, I’m proud of them,”

Eric Holder on Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Muhammad Ali, May 7, 2021. Source: NBC Washington DC.

item.title: Kevin Love on Bill Russell, Muhammad Ali
item.description:
“It’s really a profound honor if you look back at that group of men and women who I admire. Billie Jean King, Muhammad Ali, Bill Russell, to name a few. It’s very, very humbling to see my name next to those.”

Kevin Love on Bill Russell, Muhammad Ali, Jun 17, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: LeBron James on Muhammad Ali
item.description:
Not long after donating $2.5 million to support the Muhammad Ali exhibit at the Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture, LeBron James and Maverick Carter announced on Monday they will produce a multi-part documentary about Ali’s life and career for HBO.

“It’s tough to put into words how much it means to me to be a part of this project honoring the legacy and telling the extremely important story of the great Muhammad Ali,”

LeBron James on Muhammad Ali, Dec 12, 2016. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Draymond Green on Muhammad Ali
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Draymond Green:

“I wanted to meet Muhammad Ali because of the stands he took against going to the war. I wanted to meet Ali because of the way he talked junk.”

Draymond Green on Muhammad Ali, Jun 5, 2016. Source: Twitter @diamond83.
